results.title: Communications Trends in 2026: Trust, Leadership, and Credibility
results.content: Across athletics, higher ed, and my work through Jessica Poole Communications Collective, these five themes consistently rise to the top: 1️⃣ Trust over reach 2️⃣ Leaders as the primary messengers 3️⃣ AI as a tool, not the voice 4️⃣ Community-first storytelling 5️⃣ Communications as a leadership function The biggest shift? In short, in 2026, the most effective communications strategies are built on trust, led by people, powered by purpose, supported by AI, and grounded in community. Communication Strategy -mold on more modern approaches such as ‘adaptive strategy’ says Benita Steyn The Strategy of Big companies or multinationals with or without AI mandates designated spokespersons and CEO to speak to stakeholders & media to ensure that organization speaks in one voice to curb multiple voices .There is need to adopt dynamic and flexible approaches due to changing context of the business. An effective corporate communications strategy helps companies shape a strong brand image, foster trust, and build lasting relationships with employees, customers, investors, and the wider community.
